name: LoadoutSwitcher
description: Hotkey switching of saved in-game loadouts (Role Plans), with toast feedback.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Stellar Settings — Hotkeys: the loadout group with apply.1–apply.8 bindings.

fixed: Your Deep-Slumber loadout bindings are now saved separately for each character. Switching to another character — or another account — no longer applies the wrong character's bindings; each character keeps its own. Your existing bindings are kept and attached to the character you are playing when you first update.
